title: R7 verdict v2 (design 15.2)
description: proof/R7-verdict.json as sweep-proof.sh writes it: an integer schema_version and the spec clean code. The fields the haiku reader returns (claude_groups_open, tabs_beyond_baseline, orphan_tabs) and the CLEAN-NO-PROOF reason are optional and not constrained further, because the reader's output is a model reply and the writer only checks the code.
